The table of the exchanges and their trading hours

Source: R/fct_markets.R
market_table.Rd

A row per exchange, from west to east: its indices, its local time, whether it is open, at lunch or closed, with the dot of the strip of market_strip(), when that changes, its regular sessions and its time zone.

Usage

market_table(status)

Arguments

status

The result of market_status().

Value

A table of Shiny UI elements.

Examples

golemstockindices:::market_table(market_status())
